app.name: AI-Mentor
app.tagline: Safe onboarding, knowledge, and skills for modern banks

landing.headline: Onboard safely. Learn fast. Never touch real client data.
landing.subhead: An integrated platform for the AI knowledge base, dummy-data bank simulator, and skills analytics — all in one place.
landing.lede: An onboarding platform built so that no newcomer ever needs to touch a real customer to learn the trade.
landing.body: Three tracks, one platform: a retrieval-grounded knowledge base, a bank-operations simulator on 100% synthetic data, and skills analytics that map every employee's growth from intake to senior compliance.
landing.toc_assistant_desc: Trilingual Q&A grounded in internal policy — every answer cites the SOP it came from.
landing.toc_simulator_desc: Walk a synthetic customer through KYC. Get scored. Never touch a real file.
landing.toc_hr_desc: Match mentors to newcomers, watch progress live, export to iSpring.
landing.toc_profile_desc: Your XP, your streak, your onboarding deadline — in one ring.
landing.toc_skills_desc: Map every skill, surface every gap, forecast the next ninety days.
landing.constraints_synthetic: Synthetic data only. No real customer is ever read or written.
landing.constraints_latency: Sub-two-second answers — every one cites the source.
landing.constraints_trilingual: Uzbek, Russian, and English from day one.
landing.hero_title: Onboard your bank, without ever touching a real client file.
landing.hero_subtitle: AI-Mentor is the platform that trains HR, employees, and interns at financial institutions on synthetic data — with a trilingual AI assistant, a banking simulator, and skills analytics that map every growth path.
landing.roles_subtitle: AI-Mentor adapts to whoever signs in — from the HR floor to the intern desk.
landing.role_hr_blurb: Match mentors, watch onboarding progress live, and export results to iSpring.
landing.role_employee_blurb: Sharpen daily workflows with the AI assistant and grow your skill profile.
landing.role_intern_blurb: Practice real banking scenarios on synthetic clients — earn XP as you learn.
landing.features_subtitle: Six tools, one continuous learning loop — from the first question to senior compliance.
landing.feature_kb_desc: Trilingual Q&A grounded in internal policy. Every answer cites the SOP it came from.
landing.feature_simulator_desc: Walk a synthetic customer through KYC, AML, and account workflows. Get scored, never touch a real file.
landing.feature_skills_desc: See every employee's skill map, surface gaps, and forecast growth ninety days out.
landing.feature_matching_desc: Pair newcomers with the right mentor based on language, skills, and current load.
landing.feature_gamification_desc: XP, badges, streaks, and quests turn the onboarding deadline into a goal worth chasing.
landing.feature_lms_desc: Push every score, completion, and assessment into the LMS — no manual exports.
landing.constraint_synthetic: Synthetic data only. Real customers never read.
landing.constraint_trilingual: Uzbek · Russian · English from day one.

chat.title: AI Mentor
chat.empty_title: How can I help you today?
chat.empty_subtitle: Ask any question about your bank's policies, procedures, and products. Answers are grounded in internal documents.
sample_questions: Which documents are required for KYC onboarding of a new individual client?
Walk me through the steps to open a UZS current account for a legal entity.
What is the dress code policy for front-office staff?
chat.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please slow down and try again in a moment.
chat.input_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line

voice.unsupported: Voice is not supported in this browser
voice.unsupported_for_locale: Voice input is not available for {{locale}} in this browser. Try Russian or English, or type your question.
voice.error_permission: Microphone permission denied. Enable it in the browser to use voice.
voice.truncated: Answer is long — I read the first part. See the full response on screen.

helper.voice_body: Read answers aloud and dictate questions with the mic. Toggle off to keep the page silent.
helper.tip_citations: Answers cite SOPs and internal docs — open a chip to read the source.
helper.tip_languages: Ask in Uzbek, Russian, or English — the model replies in your language.
helper.tip_synthetic: Everything routed through Mentora stays on synthetic data — no real client info.

kyc.banner_synthetic: All data on this screen is 100% synthetic. No real client data is ever used.

intake.title: 1. Customer intake
intake.description: Pull the next synthetic customer file from the queue and begin the KYC review.

verify_documents.title: 2. Verify documents
verify_documents.description: Compare the customer file against the submitted documents. Mark each document as valid or invalid.

sanctions_check.title: 3. Sanctions & PEP screening
sanctions_check.description: Review hits against OFAC, EU, UN sanctions and PEP lists. Decide whether to pass or block.
sanctions_check.no_hits: No sanctions or PEP hits found.

risk_score.title: 4. Risk score
risk_score.description: Assign a risk rating based on the customer profile, document quality, and screening results.
risk_score.rationale_placeholder: Rationale (e.g., income consistent with profile, no sanctions hits, clean documents)…

decision.title: 5. Final decision
decision.description: Issue the final onboarding decision. This will be exported to the CRM.
decision.approve_desc: Open the account, send welcome packet, enroll into KYC monitoring.
decision.reject_desc: Decline the application with a formal notice. No account is opened.
decision.manual_review_desc: Escalate to a senior compliance officer for re-screening.

auth.field_password_hint: At least 8 characters with one number.
auth.signup_terms: By creating an account, you agree to the AI-Mentor training data policy.
auth.signin_subtitle: Sign in to access your AI-Mentor portal.
auth.signin_magic_link_toggle: Send me a magic link instead
auth.signin_magic_link_sent: Check {{email}} — we sent you a sign-in link.
auth.error_weak_password: Use at least 8 characters with one number.
auth.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.error_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.error_email_rate_limited: Supabase email limit reached (about 2 emails/hour on the free plan). Wait up to an hour, or in Supabase turn off Auth → Email → “Confirm email” for local dev, then sign in with password only.
auth.error_supabase_not_configured: Supabase isn't configured yet. Set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, then refresh.
auth.error_supabase_key_invalid: Supabase API key is invalid. Copy the publishable (anon) key from Project Settings → API into apps/web/.env.
auth.error_email_taken: That email is already registered. Try signing in.
auth.error_email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first (check your inbox), then sign in.
auth.error_confirmation_email: Could not send the confirmation email. In Supabase, check Auth → Email or disable “Confirm email” for local dev.
auth.error_signup_disabled: Sign-up is disabled in Supabase. Enable it under Auth → Providers → Email.
